name: std::counting_semaphore<LeastMaxValue>::counting_semaphore
intro:
1) Constructs an object of type std::counting_semaphore with the internal counter initialized to desired.

2) Copy constructor is deleted.

sections.title: Preconditions
sections.text: 1) Both desired >= 0 and desired <= max() are true.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
desired

 -

 the value to initialize counting_semaphore's counter with
